source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In six NF1 patients with osteoporosis treated with alendronate for 23 months, bone mineral density increased in five of six, but the increase was not statistically significant and one subject sustained a new stress fracture.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 71 Heerva 2014 PMID 24390519. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.n=6.
